001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.economy;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.inventory.InventoryWrapper;
004import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.obj.QUser;
005import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.Shop;
006import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.ShopType;
007import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
008import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
009import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
010
011import java.math.BigDecimal;
012import java.util.Objects;
013import java.util.Optional;
014import java.util.UUID;
015
016/**
017 * Shared context for every lifecycle event belonging to one shop transaction attempt.
018 *
019 * <p>The transaction id is unique per attempt. The shop id is QuickShop's persistent database id;
020 * callers must not use {@link Shop#getRuntimeRandomUniqueId()} for persistent integrations.</p>
021 */
022public final class ShopTransactionContext {
023
024  private final UUID transactionId;
025  private final Shop shop;
026  private final long shopId;
027  private final ShopType shopType;
028  private final ShopTransactionDirection direction;
029  private final QUser trader;
030  private final @Nullable UUID traderUniqueId;
031  private final InventoryWrapper traderInventory;
032  private final QUser shopOwner;
033  private final ItemStack item;
034  private final int tradeCount;
035  private final int itemAmount;
036  private final BigDecimal unitPrice;
037  private BigDecimal totalPrice;
038  private final @Nullable String currency;
039
040  /**
041   * Creates a transaction context with a generated transaction id.
042   *
043   * @param shop            the shop being traded with
044   * @param trader          the player or user performing the trade
045   * @param traderInventory the inventory participating in the trade
046   * @param direction       the direction from the trader's point of view
047   * @param tradeCount      the number of configured shop units being traded
048   * @param unitPrice       the price of one configured shop unit
049   * @param totalPrice      the effective total price before tax
050   */
051  public ShopTransactionContext(
052          @NotNull final Shop shop,
053          @NotNull final QUser trader,
054          @NotNull final InventoryWrapper traderInventory,
055          @NotNull final ShopTransactionDirection direction,
056          final int tradeCount,
057          @NotNull final BigDecimal unitPrice,
058          @NotNull final BigDecimal totalPrice) {
059
060    this(UUID.randomUUID(), shop, trader, traderInventory, direction, tradeCount, unitPrice, totalPrice);
061  }
062
063  /**
064   * Creates a transaction context with an explicit transaction id.
065   *
066   * @param transactionId   the unique id for this transaction attempt
067   * @param shop            the shop being traded with
068   * @param trader          the player or user performing the trade
069   * @param traderInventory the inventory participating in the trade
070   * @param direction       the direction from the trader's point of view
071   * @param tradeCount      the number of configured shop units being traded
072   * @param unitPrice       the price of one configured shop unit
073   * @param totalPrice      the effective total price before tax
074   */
075  public ShopTransactionContext(
076          @NotNull final UUID transactionId,
077          @NotNull final Shop shop,
078          @NotNull final QUser trader,
079          @NotNull final InventoryWrapper traderInventory,
080          @NotNull final ShopTransactionDirection direction,
081          final int tradeCount,
082          @NotNull final BigDecimal unitPrice,
083          @NotNull final BigDecimal totalPrice) {
084
085    this.transactionId = Objects.requireNonNull(transactionId, "transactionId");
086    this.shop = Objects.requireNonNull(shop, "shop");
087    this.shopId = shop.getShopId();
088    this.shopType = shop.getShopType();
089    this.direction = Objects.requireNonNull(direction, "direction");
090    this.trader = Objects.requireNonNull(trader, "trader");
091    this.traderUniqueId = trader.getUniqueId();
092    this.traderInventory = Objects.requireNonNull(traderInventory, "traderInventory");
093    this.shopOwner = shop.getOwner();
094    this.item = shop.getItem().clone();
095    this.tradeCount = tradeCount;
096    this.itemAmount = tradeCount * this.item.getAmount();
097    this.unitPrice = Objects.requireNonNull(unitPrice, "unitPrice");
098    this.totalPrice = Objects.requireNonNull(totalPrice, "totalPrice");
099    this.currency = shop.getCurrency();
100  }
101
102  /**
103   * @return the unique id shared by the pre, success, and failure events for this attempt
104   */
105  public @NotNull UUID getTransactionId() {
106
107    return transactionId;
108  }
109
110  /**
111   * @return the live shop involved in the transaction
112   */
113  public @NotNull Shop getShop() {
114
115    return shop;
116  }
117
118  /**
119   * @return QuickShop's persistent shop database id
120   */
121  public long getShopId() {
122
123    return shopId;
124  }
125
126  /**
127   * @return the shop type captured when the transaction started
128   */
129  public @NotNull ShopType getShopType() {
130
131    return shopType;
132  }
133
134  /**
135   * @return the transaction direction from the trader's point of view
136   */
137  public @NotNull ShopTransactionDirection getDirection() {
138
139    return direction;
140  }
141
142  /**
143   * @return the user performing the transaction
144   */
145  public @NotNull QUser getTrader() {
146
147    return trader;
148  }
149
150  /**
151   * Returns the trader UUID when the supplied user has one. QuickShop's normal player trade paths
152   * always provide it, while programmatically constructed legacy events may not.
153   *
154   * @return the trader UUID, if available
155   */
156  public @NotNull Optional<UUID> getTraderUniqueId() {
157
158    return Optional.ofNullable(traderUniqueId);
159  }
160
161  /**
162   * @return the inventory participating in the transaction
163   */
164  public @NotNull InventoryWrapper getTraderInventory() {
165
166    return traderInventory;
167  }
168
169  /**
170   * @return the shop owner captured when the transaction started
171   */
172  public @NotNull QUser getShopOwner() {
173
174    return shopOwner;
175  }
176
177  /**
178   * @return a clone of the shop item captured when the transaction started
179   */
180  public @NotNull ItemStack getItem() {
181
182    return item.clone();
183  }
184
185  /**
186   * @return the number of configured shop units requested by the trader
187   */
188  public int getTradeCount() {
189
190    return tradeCount;
191  }
192
193  /**
194   * @return the actual number of individual items transferred
195   */
196  public int getItemAmount() {
197
198    return itemAmount;
199  }
200
201  /**
202   * @return the price of one configured shop unit
203   */
204  public @NotNull BigDecimal getUnitPrice() {
205
206    return unitPrice;
207  }
208
209  /**
210   * @return the effective total price before tax
211   */
212  public @NotNull BigDecimal getTotalPrice() {
213
214    return totalPrice;
215  }
216
217  void setTotalPrice(@NotNull final BigDecimal totalPrice) {
218
219    this.totalPrice = Objects.requireNonNull(totalPrice, "totalPrice");
220  }
221
222  /**
223   * @return the configured shop currency, or {@code null} for the default currency
224   */
225  public @Nullable String getCurrency() {
226
227    return currency;
228  }
229}
